purpose: Pre-transition HumMod phenotype initialization for blinded MIMIC ventilator-response validation

arterial_gas.policy: PaO2 and PaCO2 initialize model state through HumMod chemistry; measured pH is diagnostic at fixed SID; venous state remains source prior unless independently measured

dead_space.policy: use measured PaCO2-PETCO2 fraction directly as the model dead-space fraction when a close, plausible pair exists; otherwise treat effective dead-space behavior as latent/prior-constrained

effective_ventilated_perfusion_fraction.interpretation: composite fraction of pulmonary perfusion participating in ventilated gas exchange; not a structural shunt fraction

prefit_quality.policy: domain scores remain separate; continuous scores are primary; diagnostic strata use pre-index data only

identifiability_grades.A: Strong pre-transition state for mode-specific fitting

freeze_contract: fit only from data at or before transition_time
record fitted versus measured versus prior-constrained parameters
freeze phenotype before applying index intervention
do not select phenotype using post-transition prediction error
do not use a direct PaO2 correction or free structural shunt override
record code commit and schema version for every prediction
